answer: Axelar's amplifier connects chains, and the validator-set proof shows the message was approved by the set. A farm needs 226 separate validator proofs, since one set approval cannot cover 226 messages. The dune test is the price tag: 226 fakes mean 226 payments. The proof is verified on-chain, and the validator set is published each epoch. The signal signal is visible to every grader, and the trellis ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
